## What it is

The tower at 0°, the right side, +X. Recessed 4. Three clips on a 1 m strip. Not the start of the coil.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side. The clip C is the layer plane, which is the orientation that held together. Upright clips broke across the layers.
- The foot is the 6.0 × 3.2 mm rib, 4.5 mm long, the same tab as the other three towers. It drops into a 6.2 × 3.4 mm slot.
- The 4 is recessed 0.6 mm into the top face of the rib, just above the ring. Match it to the 4 on the ring.
- The spoke is 6 mm along the tower and crosses the whole 6 mm rib. A 45° gusset, 3 mm on a side, is added at the outer face.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print this standing up. That puts the layer lines along the tube.
- Don't put it on slot 1, 2, or 3. The tab will fit, and the clips will be on the wrong heights. The number is the only key.
